# Wyoming Tint (Wyoming Tint Evanston)

> Window tinting shop in Evanston, Wyoming. Authorized XPEL window film dealer. Shop at 246 Wasatch Rd, Evanston, WY 82930. Phone (307) 444-1194. Open Tuesday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM, installs by appointment. Rated 5.0 from 25 Google reviews. Sister company of Flexible Finishes, an architectural window film company in Utah.

## Services
- Truck and SUV window tint, including matching front doors to factory privacy glass
- Car and minivan window tint
- Windshield brow strips
- Residential window film
- Commercial window film (privacy, glare and solar)

## Areas served
Evanston, Lyman, Mountain View, Fort Bridger, Bear River, Kemmerer and the rest of Uinta County, Wyoming.

## Facts
- Film: XPEL PRIME window film with the XPEL manufacturer warranty.
- Wyoming law: front side windows must let in at least 28% of light; windshield tint is limited to a strip at the top.
- Most vehicles are finished the same day.
- Free quotes by phone or text at (307) 444-1194, or email info@flexiblefinishes.com.
